title: Percolate — Pour-Over Brew Lab
description: Grind, temperature, agitation and a pour schedule drive a real extraction model — then plot the cup on the brewing control chart.
concept: Percolate is a working brew simulator: water enters the bed on your pour schedule, percolates at a rate set by grind size and bed depth, dissolves solubles with well-mixed kinetics, and the draining water carries those solids into the carafe. That gives you honest TDS and extraction-yield numbers instead of a vibe. Four brewers and four roasts change permeability, retention and solubility; the control chart, extraction curve and cup-profile radar show what each change cost you. Recipes save to the browser, export as JSON, share as a URL, and print to a PNG brew card.
features: Four brewers (V60, Chemex, Switch, French press) with real permeability, water retention and immersion/release behaviour
Editable pour schedule — add, remove and retime pours; presets for bloom+3, single pour and even 4-pour
Live extraction model: grind µm, water temperature, agitation, bloom and stir pulses all move TDS and yield
Brewing control chart with the classic 18–22% / 1.15–1.35% ideal window, a live trace and dots for every past brew
Extraction-over-time chart and a five-axis cup profile (acidity, sweetness, bitterness, body, clarity)
Recipe book in localStorage, plus JSON export, shareable URL hash and a 900×1240 PNG brew card download

interaction.mouse: Drag the sliders to change dose, ratio, grind, temperature, agitation and bloom; edit pour rows directly in the table
interaction.click: Brew / Pause / Reset, 1×–12× speed, brewer and roast presets, Stir, save or load a recipe, export JSON or a PNG brew card
interaction.touch: Tap the brewer to stir and start the brew; every control is a full-size tap target and the layout stacks on phones
interaction.keyboard: Space plays and pauses, R resets, A stirs, S saves the current recipe
